verdict.rationale: Lovable supports 'Remixing' to create an independent editable copy of an existing project (lovable-docs-13), which enables starting from a community/existing project rather than a blank prompt. However, there is no evidence of a curated template gallery, categorized starter templates, or a searchable community project marketplace comparable to other builders. missing for 10: evidence of an official template gallery/marketplace, categorized starter templates, and independent confirmation of the remix/community-project discovery flow.
